description: Deterministic eligibility rules derived ONLY from structural evidence present in the collected official DIU sources. Because the collected sources do not publish minimum SSC/HSC GPA, combined GPA, group/subject, or program-specific admission thresholds, this ruleset cannot make a decisive positive eligibility decision and therefore returns insufficient_information for normal applicants.

sources.title: Daffodil International University Admission Open for Spring 2026
Policy of Waiver and Scholarship — Spring 2026

evidence_gaps: The collected official DIU sources do not publish a minimum SSC GPA requirement.
The collected official DIU sources do not publish a minimum HSC GPA requirement.
The collected official DIU sources do not publish a combined SSC+HSC GPA requirement.
The collected official DIU sources do not publish group/subject admission requirements.
The collected official DIU sources do not publish program-specific GPA thresholds.
The collected official DIU sources do not publish admission-test scoring criteria.
Waiver percentages (e.g. DIU-WAV-001) are financial-aid criteria, not admission eligibility thresholds, and must not be converted into eligibility rules.

rules.name: Recognized undergraduate program
rules.description: The requested program must appear in the collected DIU undergraduate program registry (rules/programs.v1.json). An unrecognized program is treated as not applicable because the registry is known to be incomplete.

rules.name: Documented bachelor pathway
rules.description: Both diploma=true and diploma=false are documented bachelor admission pathways. The collected admission notice accepts SSC/Dakhil/O-Level/Diploma and HSC/Alim/A-Level/Diploma certificates, and the waiver policy contains a diploma-results table.
